topic: A taxi passenger gives the address of a building that was pulled down years ago, then disappears from the back seat.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Passenger to Nowhere

shots.narration: My taxi passenger wanted a haveli that no longer existed.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look; an old Pakistani haveli courtyard at midnight, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad.
shots.action: Bashir raises an old iron key into the lantern light.
shots.mood: Amber light on a grey beard, brown woollen shawl, white cap, and Saad's tense fa

shots.narration: Before guarding this courtyard, I drove a taxi at night.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, lantern-lit courtyard steps; Saad wears a dark green hoodie and jeans, his small torch beside him.
shots.mood: Quiet anticipation, drifting ground fog, warm lantern glow; no visible text.

shots.narration: [whispers] One foggy night, my rear door opened by itself.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, flashback on an empty Pakistani road; an unbranded taxi with blank plates, Bashir seated at the wheel.
shots.action: The taxi's rear door swings open.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, dense roadside fog, an empty doorway; no visible text.

shots.narration: The cushion sank, but I could see nobody.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the taxi's empty rear bench, plain upholstery and dark windows.
shots.action: A deep seated indentation forms in the cushion.
shots.mood: Unnatural stillness, pale moonlight across empty fabric; no visible text.

shots.narration: A voice gave an address: the old Neem Haveli.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, taxi interior with Bashir's brass lantern secured beside the dashboard, all instruments unmarked.
shots.action: Bashir turns his head toward the rear seat.
shots.mood: Lantern glow catches his worried eyes beneath his white cap; no visible text.

shots.narration: [whispers] That building had been pulled down years before.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view through the taxi windshield toward a broken haveli arch and scattered masonry.
shots.action: Bashir brings the taxi to a stop.
shots.mood: Headlights reveal collapsed walls in thick fog; no visible text or markings.

shots.narration: Still, the passenger asked me to open the door.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, roadside beside the stopped taxi, ruined haveli beyond its rear passenger door.
shots.action: Bashir pulls the rear door open.
shots.mood: Moonlit rubble, long shadows, uneasy lantern glow from the front cabin; no visib

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view into the open rear compartment, with broken masonry visible beyond the opposite window.
shots.action: The rear cushion returns to its smooth shape.
shots.mood: Empty upholstery in cold light, absolute visual stillness around the moving cush

shots.narration: [surprised] Nobody stepped out, and nobody remained inside.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide view through the open taxi door, empty rear bench and fog-covered roadside.
shots.action: Bashir bends to inspect the empty compartment.
shots.mood: His brown shawl hangs motionless against the pale fog; no visible text.

shots.narration: Only this key lay where the passenger had sat.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, rear taxi bench with a single old iron key on the plain cushion.
shots.action: Bashir lifts the key from the seat.
shots.mood: A sharp silver highlight on the key, surrounding darkness; no visible text.

shots.narration: Then the empty seat became a doorway into the haveli.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view through the taxi's open rear door; an impossible full-height haveli corridor replaces the back seat, while demolished walls remain outside.
shots.action: Bashir recoils from the impossible corridor.
shots.mood: Deep corridor shadows, distant amber glow, warped moonlit edges, peak supernatur

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, I'll explain why this key fits the abandoned station.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, return to the Pakistani haveli courtyard, brass lantern glowing between Bashir and Saad.
shots.action: Bashir places the iron key in Saad's open palm.
shots.mood: Warm light on the key, Saad's dark green sleeve, watchful faces above encroachin

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, Bashir reveals why the passenger's key fits an abandoned station.
episode.description: By lantern light, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about a taxi passenger who requested a demolished haveli—and vanished before arrival. A fictional spooky tale set on a foggy Pakistani road.
